en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a large industrial or institutional complex consisting of long, three‑story brick buildings with steep tiled roofs and many identical windows, arranged along a straight street. Smokestacks and factory structures rise behind the main buildings, and open farmland with gentle hills extends into the background. In the foreground are trees, gardens, a fence, and a few detached houses with similar steep roofs, suggesting an early‑20th‑century European industrial town or workers' housing district.
